info.title: Pareeksha API
info.description: Pareeksha crash-tests voice agents with simulated Indian-language callers and scores the calls with evidence. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer pk_live_...` (scopes: read, runs:write, audits:write, admin), except `/health` and `/webhooks/inbound/{integration_id}` (HMAC). Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.

post.summary: Receive a call recording from a source (HMAC-signed, deduped by external_id)
post.description: Headers `X-Pareeksha-Timestamp` and `X-Pareeksha-Signature: v1=<hex hmac_sha256(secret, "{ts}.{raw_body}")>`. Timestamps older than 5 minutes are rejected (408). The recording URL must be https and resolve to a public address (422 unsafe_url).

ApiKeyCreated.title: ApiKeyCreated
ApiKeyCreated.description: Returned once, on creation. The full key is never retrievable again.

file.title: File
file.description: WAV or MP3, at most 10 MB

clips.title: Clips
clips.description: ZIP with the files named in the manifest

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: simulated calls: the run it belongs to

CallRef.title: CallRef
CallRef.description: Body of a 202 that points at a call to poll (``GET /calls/{call_id}``).

CallSummaryOut.title: CallSummaryOut
CallSummaryOut.description: One row of ``GET /calls`` (Audits, Overview review queue, Calibration).

ClipResultOut.title: ClipResultOut
ClipResultOut.description: One clip x condition x engine result for the worst-clips drill-down (FR-DB-4).

ConnectorInfo.title: ConnectorInfo
ConnectorInfo.description: An installed connector with JSON Schemas so the web app can render its forms.

DimensionScore.title: DimensionScore
DimensionScore.description: One rubric dimension (docs/08). Keys are rubric dimension keys, e.g. ``task_completion``.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: webhook integrations: returned once, on creation

IntegrationUpdate.title: IntegrationUpdate
IntegrationUpdate.description: PATCH: secrets are replaced only if provided.

Recordings.title: Recordings
Recordings.description: Download URLs (``GET /calls/{id}/audio/{track}``); a track is null when not recorded.

last_passed.title: Last Passed
last_passed.description: score >= baseline - tolerance and no critical failure

RunItemOut.title: RunItemOut
RunItemOut.description: One row of the matrix view.

score_distribution.title: Score Distribution
score_distribution.description: FR-DB-2: counts of evaluated calls per 10-point score bucket (0-9, 10-19, ..., 90-100); empty until evaluations exist

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: Filled by the finalizer; fields are null until enough items are evaluated.

ScenarioDraftOut.title: ScenarioDraftOut
ScenarioDraftOut.description: Drafts are not saved scenarios; the web app shows them for review, then bulk-saves.

TestConnectionResult.title: TestConnectionResult
TestConnectionResult.description: ``ok=true`` carries the timing fields; ``ok=false`` carries ``error`` and ``detail``.

SseSnapshot.description: ``event: snapshot`` - sent first, and again after every reconnect.
SseSnapshot.title: SseSnapshot

ApiKey.description: API key from POST /api-keys (shown once). Scopes: read, runs:write, audits:write, admin (admin implies all).
